mainEntity.name: How much do I need for a down payment in Texas?

acceptedAnswer.text: It depends on the loan. Conventional loans commonly start around 3 to 5 percent, FHA at 3.5 percent, and VA loans can require nothing down for eligible buyers. Ask a lender to price several options against your situation before assuming you need 20 percent.

A Texas option period is a negotiated window, typically a few days to about a week, during which the buyer may terminate for any reason in exchange for a non-refundable option fee. It is when inspections happen and repairs are negotiated.

mainEntity.name: Does the buyer pay the agent?

acceptedAnswer.text: Compensation is negotiable and is agreed in writing before you tour homes. We explain exactly what you would owe and what, if anything, a seller is offering, before you sign anything.
Once an offer is accepted, a financed purchase in Texas commonly closes in about 30 to 45 days. Cash purchases can close faster. Finding the right home is usually the longer part of the process.
